title: User Login Success with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that user can successfully log in using valid email and password through Supabase authentication and is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/login page
Enter valid email 'admin@tac.app' and correct password 'Test@1498'
Click login button
Check user is redirected to dashboard overview page
Verify user session is active and Supabase authentication token is set

title: User Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails when user inputs invalid email or password and appropriate error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/login page
Enter invalid email or incorrect password
Click login button
Check error message for invalid credentials is displayed
Verify user is not redirected and remains on login page

title: Dashboard Overview Load Performance and Data Accuracy
description: Validate Dashboard Overview loads within performance budgets and all live metrics, charts, shipment pipeline, and maps display accurate real-time data.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to Dashboard Overview (Mission Control)
Confirm page load time is under 2 seconds on 4G network simulation
Verify initial JS bundle is less than 50KB and total JS less than 200KB for this route
Check live metrics grid shows correct up-to-date KPI values
Confirm Kanban shipment pipeline reflects latest shipment statuses with correct data
Verify vehicle map shows real-time geolocation updates with latency under 500ms
Check quick actions panel buttons are enabled and functional

title: Shipment Creation Multi-step Wizard
description: Verify shipment creation via multi-step form works correctly including form validation, data persistence between steps, and final submission.

steps.description: Navigate to shipment management page
Initiate new shipment creation
Fill in required fields in step 1 and click Next
Validate no errors and progress to step 2
Fill in optional and required fields in step 2 and click Next
Validate data persists from step 1 and no form validation errors
Confirm and submit shipment creation in final step
Verify shipment details appear in shipment list and database updated

title: Shipment Management - Barcode Scanning with Offline Queue
description: Verify barcode scanning workflow supports live scanning, multi-mode inputs, and offline queuing with synchronization upon reconnect.

steps.description: Access shipment scanning page on mobile PWA
Scan barcode using camera input
Validate scanned package is correctly associated with shipment in system
Turn off network connection
Scan multiple barcodes offline
Verify scanned barcodes are queued offline locally
Restore network connection
Confirm queued barcodes synchronize with backend without data loss

title: Real-time Shipment Tracking with Status Filters
description: Verify real-time tracking page updates shipment location, timeline, and status with filters applied; ensure UI updates smoothly without lag on large datasets.

steps.description: Navigate to tracking page
Apply various status filters (e.g., In Transit, Delivered, Exception)
Check shipment cards update according to filter criteria
Validate timeline visualizations reflect real-time status changes within 500ms latency
Confirm map integration updates shipment positions interactively

title: Manifest Management - AI-powered Route Optimization and Driver Assignment
description: Validate creation and editing of manifests using AI optimization, correct driver assignment, and route preview with live tracking updates.

steps.description: Open manifest management page
Create new manifest selecting shipments for optimization
Trigger AI-powered route optimization
Verify routes generated are logically optimized for distance and time
Assign drivers to routes
Confirm driver assignment saves correctly and is reflected on manifest
Preview route on map with animated tracking
Validate live tracking updates are received and displayed in realtime
Close manifest and mark as completed
Confirm manifest status updates and is removed from active list

title: Invoice Generation and Multi-channel Delivery
description: Test invoice creation with multi-currency and GST compliance, sending invoice via WhatsApp Business API and fallback channels with delivery confirmation metrics.

steps.description: Access invoice creation page
Generate invoice for shipment with multi-currency selection and GST fields
Verify invoice displays correct amounts, taxes, and formatting
Send invoice via WhatsApp Business API using predefined templates
Check delivery confirmation is received and logged
Simulate WhatsApp failure and verify fallback SMS/email delivery
Confirm fallback channel delivery is successful and logged

title: Analytics Dashboard Charts and Export Reporting
description: Validate interactive BI charts for operations, finance, and customer analytics render correctly with lazy loading and data export functionality works on large datasets.

steps.description: Navigate to analytics dashboard
Verify charts render correctly with accurate data and visual fidelity
Check charts support lazy loading with no perceptible lag on datasets up to 10,000 records
Use date range selectors to filter analytics
Confirm charts and KPI cards update accordingly
Export current analytics report as CSV and PDF
Verify exported files contain correct and complete data

title: Exception Handling Workflow for Failed and Delayed Shipments
description: Validate user ability to manage shipment exceptions including identifying delayed shipments, applying resolution workflows, and updating statuses.

steps.description: Access exceptions management page
Filter shipments by delayed or failed status
Check exception list correctly displays all matching shipments
Select a delayed shipment and initiate resolution workflow
Update shipment status post resolution and add audit log entry
Confirm shipment status reflects update and audit log records changes

title: Barcode Scanning UI Accessibility and Multi-mode Input
description: Verify barcode scanning component supports camera, manual input, and keyboard modes with accessibility compliance and offline support.

steps.description: Navigate to barcode scanning page
Verify all UI controls have proper ARIA labels and keyboard focus management
Input barcode manually and validate processing
Use keyboard input mode to enter barcode
Check barcode data is accepted and processed identically to camera input
Test offline scanning queue behavior with multiple inputs
Verify UI shows offline queue indicator and sync status updates on reconnect

title: Security - Role-Based Access and RLS Enforcement
description: Ensure role-based access control and Row Level Security (RLS) are enforced correctly, preventing unauthorized data access across all modules.

steps.description: Log in as different roles (admin, operations, finance, warehouse)
Attempt to access restricted pages and data beyond role permissions
Verify user is blocked or access denied messages are shown
Perform data queries directly hitting backend endpoints to test RLS enforcement
Confirm data returned complies with role restrictions, no unauthorized data leaks
Test audit log captures all access attempts
Validate audit logs record user, time, action, and success/failure status

title: Accessibility Audit for Dashboard and Core Pages
description: Conduct accessibility checks to ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, and color contrast across dashboard and key components.

steps.description: Navigate through dashboard pages using keyboard only
Confirm logical tab order and visible focus outlines on all interactive elements
Use screen reader to navigate dashboard overview and shipment management
Verify correct ARIA roles and labels announced, descriptive contextual information present
Ensure semantic OKLCH color tokens meet WCAG contrast ratio requirements

title: Notification System Delivery and UI Behavior
description: Validate real-time notification system shows notifications via bell icon and toast messages, with correct content and dismissal behaviors.

steps.description: Trigger system notifications such as shipment status updates, invoice sent, or exceptions
Verify notification bell icon shows unread count
Confirm toast notification appears with correct message content and icon
Dismiss toast notification manually
Check toast disappears correctly and bell count updates
Reload page and verify persisted notification status in bell

title: Mobile PWA Barcode Scanning Offline Support for Warehouse Staff
description: Test PWA mobile experience with offline barcode scanning, ensuring scans queue offline and sync correctly, and UI is responsive on different device sizes.

steps.description: Access barcode scanning PWA on mobile devices with varying screen sizes
Verify UI adapts responsively and maintains WCAG compliance
Disable network connection and perform multiple barcode scans
Validate scans are stored offline with UI indication
Re-enable network and observe synchronization of all queued scans
Confirm backend database is updated and local queue cleared

title: Command Palette Keyboard Shortcuts and Navigation
description: Verify global command palette accessibility, supported keyboard shortcuts for quick navigation, and that commands execute expected actions.

steps.description: Press configured keyboard shortcut to open command palette
Confirm palette UI appears with focus in input field
Type keywords related to navigation or actions (e.g., 'shipments', 'create manifest')
Verify relevant commands appear filtered in the palette
Select command from palette and execute
Validate UI navigates or performs requested action
